backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing a simple user authentication system with in-memory username/password storage, exposing register and login functions (password hashing is a no-op placeholder).
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing short summaries of all frontend source files, describing each component's purpose and notable changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file that defines CSS custom properties for a light/dark color theme using OKLCH values, covering backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell for the ZoritLegends React app, mounting the app into a root div and loading the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up TanStack Router with home and team routes, wrapping the entire app in AuthProvider for global authentication state.
frontend/src/components/AuthModal.tsx: Pixel/retro-styled modal dialog handling both login and registration flows, using React Query mutations to call the backend and updating auth context on success.
Modal dialog that displays the ZoritLegends Minecraft server IP with step-by-step join instructions and a clipboard copy button.
frontend/src/components/layout/Community: Renders the Community section of the landing page, displaying server stats (players, active users, staff) and player testimonials, with a button that opens a JoinServerModal.
frontend/src/components/layout/FeaturesS: Renders the Features/Game Modes section showcasing Survival, PvP Arena, and Events cards with images and fallback icons, plus extra feature highlights like low latency and 24/7 uptime.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer with the ZoritLegends logo, a tagline, a Discord social link, quick navigation links, and a copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/layout/HeroSecti: Renders the full-screen hero section with a background banner, animated pixel particles, server status badge, headline, and buttons that open JoinServerModal and LearnMoreModal.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navbar.ts: Renders the fixed top navigation bar with logo, anchor/page nav links, a Join Server modal trigger, and auth controls (login/logout) using AuthContext, with mobile hamburger menu support.
frontend/src/components/layout/RanksSect: Displays a 'Server Ranks' section with five tiers (Novice to Legend), each shown as a styled card with emoji, color theming, and hover effects. All ranks are described as free and earned through gameplay.
frontend/src/components/layout/RoleHiera: Renders a 'Staff Structure' section listing 12 staff roles (Owner through Builder) with their max player counts and color-coded styling in a hierarchical panel layout.
frontend/src/components/layout/StaffList: Displays the current staff roster grouped by role, showing each member's name and whether the slot is occupied or vacant, with per-role color theming.
frontend/src/components/layout/StoreSect: Renders a server store section with three purchasable packages (Starter Pack, Legend Rank, Mythic Rank), highlighting the most popular option and listing features and prices for each.
frontend/src/components/LearnMoreModal.t: Scrollable modal presenting the ZoritLegends server welcome content, feature list with emoji icons, and descriptive paragraphs in a pixel/retro Minecraft style.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides a React context for simple username-based authentication state with login and logout functions, exposed via the useAuth hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, returning an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current Internet Identity, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication provider and hook using DFINITY's AuthClient, managing login status, identity persistence, and exposing login/clear functions via React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports useRegister and useLogin mutation hooks that call the corresponding backend actor methods with username and password credentials.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, defines a purple/white OKLCH CSS variable theme, and declares reusable component classes like pixel borders, minecraft buttons, and glow effects.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component that composes the Navbar, HeroSection, FeaturesSection, RanksSection, and Footer layout components into a full landing page.
frontend/src/pages/Team.tsx: Team page that displays a Discord join banner, a role hierarchy section, and a full staff list section, all wrapped with the shared Navbar and Footer.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with custom OKLCH-based purple color palette, pixel/retro fonts, custom shadows, border radii, and animation keyframes, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking the pending feature request to deploy and publish the ZoritLegends application to the Internet Computer network.
